t_advice_summary_textbox.text: There are 8 different colored gnomes. They are spilt into two groups. One group being the red, purple, brown and pink gnomes. The other group is blue, green, orange, yellow. You basically have to switch between these when you aren't getting enough mushrooms.

vb_textbox.text: In the game you have two groups of gnomes. Each group is either with the yellow or red basket. The red basket are the gnomes that are red, pink, purple, and brown. The yellow basket are the gnomes that are blue, green, yellow, and orange. Each time you tap a gnome it takes you to the forest that allows you to get mushrooms. Each time you get a basket with 3 or lower mushrooms you need to alternate to the other basket. If your basket has 4 or more mushrooms stay choosing that basket.
